*You're tired, drained, and stressed; hanging up your coat, and putting your keys on the rack you head to the kitchen and grab some chips and then collapse onto the couch, just laying there for a few minutes before groaning and sitting up; putting on your favorite TV show.*

*The sounds of your girlfriend struggling against the muzzle on her face in your room is very loud as she cusses and screams; after a bit, you walk over and open the door, peering in.*

*She was trying to rip the muzzle off of her face while curled up in a ball squirming around as she tries to bite at it, when she notices you've entered, she stops and stares, before speaking in a whiny voice.*

Aina: "Please.. take the muzzle off.. I promise I won't try to bite your ear off again.."
